text.body: || nirvāṇopaniṣat || nirvāṇopaniṣadvedyaṃ nirvāṇānandatundilam | traipadānandasāmrājyaṃ svamātramiti cintayet || oṃ vāṇme manasi pratiṣṭhitā | mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitam | āvirāvīrma edhi | vedasya mā āṇīsthaḥ | śrutaṃ me mā prahāsīḥ| anenādhītenāhorātrānsandadhāmi | ṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi | satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi | tanmāmavatu | tadvaktāramavatu | avatu māmavatu vaktāram| oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || atha nirvāṇopaniṣadaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | paramahaṃsaḥ so'ham | parivrājakāḥ paścimaliṇgāḥ | manmathakṣetrapālāḥ | gaganasiddhāntaḥ| amṛtakallolanadī | akṣayaṃ nirañjanam | niḥsaṃśaya ṛṣiḥ | nirvāṇo devatā | niṣkulapravṛttiḥ | niṣkevalaṅyānam ||1-11|| ūrdhvāmnāyaḥ | nirālamba pīṭhaḥ | saṃyogadīkṣā | viyogopadeśaḥ | dīkṣāsantoṣapānaṃ ca | dvādaśāvadityāvalokanam | vivekarakṣā | karuṇaiva keliḥ | ānandamālā | ekāntaguhāyāṃ muktāsanasukhagoṣṭī | akalpitabhikṣāśī | haṃsācāraḥ |sarvabhūtāntarvartī haṃsa iti pratipādanam ||12-24|| dhairyakanthā | udāsīnakaupīnam | vicāradaṇḍaḥ | brahmāvalokayogapaṭṭaḥ | śriyāṃ pādukā | parecchācaraṇam | kuṇḍalinībandhaḥ| parāpavādamukto jīvanmuktaḥ | śivayoganidrā ca | khecarīmudrā ca | paramānandī | nirgaṇaguṇatrayam | vivekalabhyam| manovāgagocaram | anityaṃ jagadyajjanitaṃ svapnajagadabhragajāditulyam | tathā dehādisaṇghātaṃ mohaguṇajālakalitaṃ tadrajjusarpavatkalpitam | viṣṇuvidhyādiśatābhidhānalakṣyam | aṇkuśo mārgaḥ | śūnyaṃ na saṃketaḥ | parameśvarasattā | satyasiddhayogo maṭhaḥ | amarapadaṃ na tatsvarūpam | ādibrahmasvasaṃvit | ajapā gāyatrī | vikāradaṇḍo dhyeyaḥ|| manonirodhinī kanthā | yogena sadānandasvarūpadarśanam | ānandabhikṣāśī | mahāśmaśāne'pyānandavane vāsaḥ | ekāntasthānam | ānandamaṭham | unmanyavasthā | śāradā ceṣṭā | unmanī gatiḥ | nirmalagātram | nirālambapīṭham | amṛtakallolānandakriyā | pāṇḍaragaganamahāsiddhāntaḥ | śamadamādidivyaśaktyācaraṇe kṣetrapātrapaṭutā | parāvarasaṃyogaḥ | tārakopadeśāḥ | advaitasadānando devatā|| niyamaḥ svātarindriyanigrahaḥ | bhayamohaśokakrodhatyāgastyāgaḥ | parāvaraikyarasāsvādanam | aniyāmakatvanirmalaśaktiḥ| svaprakāśabrahmatattve śivaśaktisampuṭita prapañcacchedanam | tathā patrākṣākṣikamaṇḍaluḥ bhavābhāvadahanam | bibhratyākāśādhāram | śivaṃ turīyaṃ yaṅyopavītam | tanmayā śikhā | cinmayaṃ cotsṛṣṭiraṇḍam | saṃtatokṣikamaṇḍalum | karmanirmūlanaṃ kanthā| māyāmamatāhaṃkāradahanam | smaśāne anāhatāṇgī | nistraiguṇyasvarūpānusandhānaṃ samayaṃ | bhrāntihananam | kāmādivṛttidahanam | kāṭhinyadṛḍhakaupīnam | cirājinavāsaḥ | anāhatamantraḥ | akriyayaiva juṣṭam | svecchācārasvasvabhāvo mokṣaḥ | paraṃ brahma plavavadācaraṇam | brahmacaryaśāntisaṃgrahaṇam | brahmacaryāśrame'dhītya vānaprasthāśrame'dhītyā sa sarvasaṃvinnyāsaṃ saṃnyāsam | ante brahmākhaṇḍākāram | nityaṃ sarvasandehanāśanam ||49-60|| etannirvāṇadarśanaṃ | śiṣyaṃ putraṃ vinā na deyamityupaniṣat ||61|| oṃ vāṇme manasīti śāntiḥ || iti nirvāṇopaniṣatsamāptā |
